messages.content: What's the lowest score in the Flappy Bird game?

function.name: game_tracker_high_score
function.description: Retrieves the highest score recorded in the specified game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game_name.description: The name of the game to get the high score for.

username.description: The username of the player. (optional) Default: 'john'

platform.description: The platform where the game was played, i.e PC, Xbox, Playstation, Mobile.

message.content:
In **Flappy Bird** there’s no way to earn a negative score—your score starts at 0 and only increases as you successfully fly past pipes.  
So the *lowest* achievable score is simply **0**, which happens whenever you touch a pipe on your very first attempt.
message.reasoning:
The user asks "What's the lowest score in the Flappy Bird game?" They want presumably the minimum possible score or maybe they mean what is the lowest score achieved historically? In Flappy Bird, you start at zero and each successful pass increments your score; if you die immediately after starting, you'd have a score of 0. So the lowest score would be 0.

But perhaps they're asking about some record low? But likely it's just 0 because that's how scoring works. There's no negative scores. So answer: 0 points.

We can also mention that the first time you hit an obstacle you'll still have a score of 1? Actually I think when you cross a pipe pair you increment score. If you fail before crossing one, you stay at 0. So yes, lowest score is 0.

Thus respond accordingly. No need to call function.
